publication_year_note: Published in Ambiente & Sociedade, São Paulo, v. XVIII, n. 1, p. 59-74, jan.-mar. 2015 (submitted 05/03/2013; accepted 27/03/2013; no separate online-first year printed).
rationale: This 16-page article is a purely qualitative documental and theoretical essay examining social participation and social control in Brazilian sanitation policy (Federal Constitution of 1988, Law 8.142/1990, Law 11.445/2007, and Municipal Basic Sanitation Plans guidelines) through the lens of Raymundo Faoro and social science literature. Table 1 lists only legislative and policy documents reviewed; the paper contains zero quantitative data, sample sizes, descriptive statistics, or inferential statistical tests.
